2 ὑποκληθεῖ cod., ὑποκλιθῇ scripsimus. Sed et cetera corrupta sunt. 4 cod.
εἴδολα (et sic paene ubique). 5 χαρακτῆρας ubique cum articulo generis fem.
6 cod. ὀνόμασε. 10 ὄντι cod. (et sic paene ubique), οὔσης (vel ὄντος) scripsimus.
εἰκόνας cod., εἰκόνα scripsimus. 13 cod. ὁ δεῖνος, delevimus ὁ. ἃς βαστάζεις
cod., εἰσβάσταζε scripsimus (et sic alias). 14 cod. περὶ χαρῶς. 16 ἐνυπνιάσθω
cod., ἐνυπνιᾶσθαι scripsimus. 18 cod. ἀγγέλον (et sic alias). 21 στάνιον vel

sections.en: 2 ὑποκληθεῖ ('he/she/it is called upon') the codex has, ὑποκλιθῇ ('he/she/it may be laid down') we have written. But the rest are also corrupt. 4 the codex has εἴδολα ('idols') (and thus almost everywhere). 5 χαρακτῆρας ('characters') everywhere with the article of the feminine gender. 6 the codex has ὀνόμασε ('he/she named'). 10 ὄντι ('being') the codex has (and thus almost everywhere), οὔσης ('being') (or ὄντος ('being')) we have written. εἰκόνας ('images') the codex has, εἰκόνα ('image') we have written. 13 the codex has ὁ δεῖνος ('so-and-so'), we have deleted ὁ ('the'). ἃς βαστάζεις ('which you carry') the codex has, εἰσβάσταζε ('carry in') we have written (and thus elsewhere). 14 the codex has περὶ χαρῶς ('about joy'). 16 ἐνυπνιάσθω ('let him/her dream') the codex has, ἐνυπνιᾶσθαι ('to dream') we have written. 18 the codex has ἀγγέλον ('angel') (and thus elsewhere). 21 στάνιον ('tin') or rather στάννιον ('tin') = stannum. the codex has χρίζεις ('you anoint'). 22 μέλλων ('intending') the codex has; corrected by Cumont. Cf. Wessely, Denkschr. Akad. Wien, XXXVI, 1888, v. 322 s. (Kroll). θέλεις ('you wish') conjectured by Kroll; but cf. 42, 16.

summary.headline: Love Charms and Dream Images
summary.text: Magical formulae for love charms: instructions for making inscribed images under solar, lunar, and astrological conditions, invoking the angels of the Sun, Aries, Moon, and Hermes to induce love, obedience, and joyful dreams.
